body: This PR looks finished to us: it merges cleanly with main, the body names the issue, the tests and the Changelog line, and there have been no new commits for some hours. Our review agents only review PRs marked **Ready for review**, so a draft waits without a review. When you think it is done, please click **Ready for review** (or `gh pr ready 2542`), and it gets a review in the next pass. If it is still in progress, ignore this comment.

<!-- pr-reviewer: a2b549a79696656ade6fef15921cfc85c40f773b -->
**Verdict: ready**

Built and tested locally at this head, on Windows, in a worktree, debug profile. I did not write this change. GitHub reports `MERGEABLE`.

## What I checked

- The design is right: the file goes through `CommandKind::ImportFile` / `CommandKind::OpenProjectFile` on the first frame - the same commands as the dialogs and a drop. No direct world write (Everything is a Command). Refusals reuse `state.refuse_drop`, so the status line and the empty-project start behave as for a bad drop.
- `cli_options`: the one walker keeps option values out of the file list; a bare `-` is not a file; a refused argument list gives `files() == []`, so `parse` still owns the error. `.CAMPROJ` case-folds (pinned by a test).
- No `unwrap`/`expect`/`panic!` outside tests in the new code. New files: 58 and 120 lines; `cli_options.rs` is 253 lines.

## Local results at `a2b549a79`

- `cargo test -p camcraft-ui --lib`: 1096 passed, 0 failed, 7 ignored (includes the 7 tests of `launch_file_tests.rs`).
- `cargo clippy -p camcraft-ui --all-targets`: clean for `camcraft-ui`. One `camcraft-app` warning shows at `operation/heights.rs:128` (needless borrow); it is pre-existing on main and not from this PR.
- Not run: the `headless_bin` and the other `camcraft-ui` integration binaries; the diff keeps their signatures untouched.

## Non-blockers

- `camcraft-ui --headless part.sc` ignores the file: the headless path does not call `files()`. Filed as #2648 (P7): a headless start with a file should open it or refuse by name.
- macOS `open -a CamCraft part.sc` (Apple Events) is out of scope as the body says; the body is complete otherwise (`Changelog:` and `Fixes #2462` present).

## Not checked

- Not run on macOS or Linux (the author's runs are macOS; the code has no platform branches).
- Not run as an installed app from a file double-click.
